title: Hacker Behind GTA VI Leaks Sentenced and Released
excerpt: Arion Kurtaj, responsible for leaking GTA VI development videos, received a seven-year prison sentence and was released on license.
body_html:
The individual responsible for hacking game developer Rockstar Games and leaking early footage of Grand Theft Auto VI has received a sentence of seven years in prison, with release on license. Arion Kurtaj entered guilty pleas regarding the security breaches affecting Rockstar, along with attacks on other companies including Revolut and Uber.

Following the breach at Rockstar in 2022, approximately 90 videos showing unreleased footage of GTA VI were leaked to the public years ahead of the scheduled launch. Due to medical assessments determining he was not fit to stand trial in the traditional manner, a jury previously decided whether he committed the acts rather than issuing a criminal conviction.
